text:
[BEDWARS]
+ added clutch (mc vape clutch)
+ added voidregentautoclutch (dashes the void axe back to ground when you fall off)
+ added overlayeditor (recolour the block outline and fill, glides between blocks)
+ added clouds (size, colour and transparency)
+ added autolasso (throws lassy's lasso at whoever you're meleeing)
+ added autowhim (casts whim's book, follows your element)
+ added autosophia (shoots the frost staff, swaps out of mist mode itself)
+ added autofreiya (detonates ice stacks once enemies are frozen enough)
+ added autonazar (heals off life force, empowers near enemies)
+ added autosilas (swaps aura for enemies or hurt allies, presses the attack)
+ added autovoidknight (feeds iron/emeralds, ascends in fights)
+ added autoyeti (glacial roar once enough enemies are near you)
+ added autoxurot (dragon breath while in dragon form)
+ added autozola (soul links everyone you see or hit, relinks on break, stops at the cap)
+ added namehider (fake username and display name everywhere on your screen)
+ added use sophia and use whim to killaura fasthits, projectileaura and autoshoot
+ added infinite range to autosheepherder (cap also raised 20 -> 200)
+ added gui check to autoadetunde
+ added the game's own legit checks to autoclicker (no swinging on sigrid's elk or while casting)
+ added target mode to projectileaimbot
+ added visualize to cheststeal
+ added animations to replaymod (plays all animation ingame)
+ added sounds to replaymod
+ added armor to replaymod (everyone wears what they had on)
+ fixed autosheepherder erroring on maps with no sheep
+ fixed autozeno not working
+ fixed autofish auto cast not working
+ fixed autofish blacklist
+ fixed skinchanger not working after you die
+ fixed breaker legit mode mining around an already opened bed
+ fixed block-in shifting the whole wall when your position moved a little
+ fixed block-in nott working with block priority set to hardest
+ fixed setemote never playing emotes that use a display animation
+ fixed killaura predictions
+ made killaura get 35 hitreg cons (just dont attack for too long..)
+ made killaura, silentaura and reach have better attack range
+ made the scaffold visual glide instead of teleporting
+ made replaymod rebuild everyone as their blocky bedwars character
+ made replaymod way smoother (it was only saving 10 samples a second)
+ made replaymod name replays by gamemode and date, newest first
- removed killaura hit chance
[GENERAL]
+ readded solara and xeno support
+ made projectile prediction way more op
+ made prediction lead people circling or curving around you instead of aiming straight ahead
+ made script more optimized
+ added new and updated tags on modules in the gui
+ added a changelogs window (shows whenever catvape updates)
+ added a preset config prompt after new update
+ added public profiles (browse, like, download and publish configs, manage your uploads)
+ replaced the profiles "type name" box with CREATE NEW + PUBLIC buttons
+ added the new profile view (name field, module count and list)
+ readded the hide vape button option
+ fixed sync to "default" profile not copying your current profile
